tests.B same-period futures check: the same code on Databento NQ and ES 1-minute trades 2018-01 .. 2026-09 (does the Dukascopy result hold on real futures prices?)

costs: 1 bp per side (as FPA-1) and 0.5 bp (a realistic micro-contract cost with limit entries is not assumed; 0.5 bp only reported)
